lines.trans: Dmitry Vladimirovich, good morning to you!
Hey, Viktor, I am not giving you money!
I already paid you two paychecks.
What did you want?
Why, I am not calling for money!
Really? Then why are you calling?
Tonight is an important football match.
Is your beloved Spartak playing again?
Yes, and I have reliable insider info!
Viktor, sports betting is dangerous.
I need a small advance until tomorrow.
I know your advances, Viktor.
You will not get a single kopeck!
Dmitry, you will regret this!

present есть; у меня есть = I have

выдать.gloss: to issue, give out, hand out

examples.trans: The cashier issued the money against the receipt.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular
plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

жить на зарплату = to live on one's salary

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
